messages:
priya: Quick thought — do we standardize on proto-first + gRPC for internal services and put a lightweight JSON gateway at the edge, or push proto everywhere? Thinking about quota attribution and the console UX.

alex: Proto-first for internal makes sense to keep strong typing and SDKs lean. But client ergonomics matter a lot for product teams.

sam: Gateway mapping adds surface area though. Lip-sync bugs, mismatched defaults, and rollout complexity. How do we propagate route metadata so routing policies and quota buckets work reliably?

lee: We can have the gateway attach stable route headers, e.g. `x-route-id` + `x-route-version` so routing/quotas/console all key off the same value. Example: `x-route-id: user.v2.CreateUser`

priya: Headers are fine but fragile across retries & proxies. We also need dedupe for quota accounting. Traces must include a canonical route id so console charts line up with traces.

tess: :thumbsup: Agree. Suggest canonicalizing to grpc method name + short hash of relevant args as the canonical signature. Gateway adds `x-canonical-route` and `x-invocation-id`.

sam: On telemetry — hosted runtime gives us token-level counters; internal services won't. For internal we should emit per-request cost estimates and token-ish metrics where applicable. Console should surface both.

alex: Rollout UX note: when we change API shape, console needs to show canary split, fallback rules, and quick rollback actions. If we have `x-route-version` both runtime and console can display split percentages.

priya: Can we avoid proliferating headers? Maybe a single `x-route-metadata` JSON blob base64 encoded so we can extend without changing the header list.

lee: Base64 blob works but proxies need to parse it to apply routing policies — adds CPU. Also validation is needed so bad blobs don't break UI. Enforce proto schema at the gateway to validate.

tess: Operational ask: gateways live in the 3ms p99 latency budget. JSON decode + base64 + validation could push us. We should benchmark and keep fast paths for the common case.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployed proto->json-mapper v1 to staging
logs: sampled 200 requests, median +0.8ms, p99 +2.9ms

priya: Good data. Next steps: 1) Define `x-canonical-route` and `x-route-version` as required proto annotations, 2) Gateway mapping doc with examples (json blob vs headers), 3) Console changes: show route metadata + canary split + quick rollback. I'll draft an RFC this week.

alex: Ping me when the RFC lands — I want to propose metric name conventions and telemetry events.

sam: Also add a hard requirement: quota dedupe must rely on server-side unique invocation ids to handle retries.

priya: Noted. Thanks all — will send draft in #rfc when ready.
